fields.power: 120 V AC projector; 5 V DC Raspberry Pi
fields.trigger: Current: Pi auto-starts loop at boot and projector starts manually; planned: automatic projector startup
fields.controller: Raspberry Pi 4; projector automation interface — TBD
fields.network: Wi-Fi; planned Hub control plus Pi and playback monitoring
fields.notes: Confirmed walkthrough: the Raspberry Pi automatically starts the silent Mia & Roy projection loop when powered; the projector currently requires manual startup. Future HollowNet integration through the Exterior Grounds Zone Controller must show Pi-online and video-loop-running status and provide start, stop, restart-loop and reboot-Pi controls. Automatic projector startup is also required; its implementation remains TBD pending the projector model and supported control method.

fields.name: Arizona Mist System
fields.room: Tech Shed / Bridge / Furnace Room / Bog / Graveyard
fields.outputs: Property-wide mist; Bridge branch; Furnace Room branch with two steam-simulation valves; Bog branch; Graveyard branch
fields.controller: Arizona Mist machine local controls — exact model TBD
fields.maintenanceLog: HollowNet maintenance record required: log date, operator, pump/filter/nozzle/valve inspection or service, leaks, repairs, winterization, recommissioning and notes. No service events are recorded yet.
fields.notes: Confirmed walkthrough: one large Arizona Mist machine in the Tech Shed serves the property. Distribution lines branch to the Bridge, Furnace Room, Bog and Graveyard. The Furnace Room branch has two valves that simulate steam escaping through pipes. The machine starts from a manual switch and remains completely local; the Main Hub provides documentation only, including reference material, maintenance history and notes. Attach the exact model, manual, plumbing map, valve labels and service instructions when available.
